## Verified Production Applications (Published on Google Play)

### 1. CivicCoach — AI US Citizenship 2026
- Application Category: Educational / Civics Prep & AI Mock Interview
- Google Play Store URL: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.us.citizenship.test.naturalization.civics.prep&hl=en
- Package ID: `com.us.citizenship.test.naturalization.civics.prep`
- Key Features:
  - Realistic AI Voice mock interviews simulating official USCIS officer oral examinations.
  - Speech-to-Text (STT) and automated accuracy evaluation.
  - Complete 128 & 100 official USCIS naturalization questions with audio narration.
  - Spaced repetition flashcards powered by the SuperMemo-2 (SM-2) algorithm.
  - Dynamic ZIP-code based elected officials lookup (Senators, Governors, Representatives).
  - Dual bilingual support (English & Spanish).
- Tech Stack: Flutter, Dart, Drift ORM, SQLite, Speech-to-Text, flutter_tts, Provider.

### 2. Ethiopian Calendar — Zemen App
- Application Category: Utilities & Cultural Tools
- Google Play Store URL: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ethiopia.zemen.calendar.aqotater.ethiopian.habesha&hl=en
- Package ID: `com.ethiopia.zemen.calendar.aqotater.ethiopian.habesha`
- Key Features:
  - 13-month Geez calendar navigation and bi-directional Gregorian-Ethiopian date converter.
  - Live 12-hour sunrise Ethiopian clock widget.
  - Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo fasting calendar, saints days, and Islamic prayer schedules.
  - National holiday countdowns and event reminders.
- Tech Stack: Flutter, Dart, Custom Calendar Engine, Local Storage, Provider.

### 3. ZenPeace — Pomodoro & Mindful Flow
- Application Category: Productivity & Mindfulness
- Google Play Store URL: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zenpeace.pomodoro.focus.timer.mindfulstate&hl=en
- Package ID: `com.zenpeace.pomodoro.focus.timer.mindfulstate`
- Key Features:
  - Customizable Pomodoro interval timer with focus and break rituals.
  - Curated ambient soundscapes (piano, lofi beats, rain, ocean waves).
  - Productivity analytics and daily completion streak charts via `fl_chart`.
  - Haptic feedback and minimalistic distraction-free UI.
- Tech Stack: Flutter, Dart, Provider State Management, just_audio, fl_chart.

### 4. Health Tracker — Vitals & BP Monitor
- Application Category: Health & Fitness
- Google Play Store URL: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vitals.bp.family.health.tracker&hl=en
- Package ID: `com.vitals.bp.family.health.tracker`
- Key Features:
  - Comprehensive vital sign logging: Blood Pressure (systolic/diastolic), Pulse, Blood Glucose, Temperature.
  - Visual trend analysis with weekly/monthly health report cards.
  - Local database export and historical health log tracking.
- Tech Stack: Flutter, Dart, SQFlite, Provider, Data Visualization.

## Technical Competencies

### 1. Mobile & Cross-Platform Development
- Frameworks: Flutter (Mobile, Web, Desktop), Dart.
- Platforms: Android, iOS, Web, Windows/macOS Desktop from a unified single codebase.
- UI/UX: Custom Flutter widgets, fluid animations (Framer Motion principles, Rive, Canvas), responsive layout systems, Neumorphism, dark/light themes.

### 2. Backend & Cloud Infrastructure
- Supabase: Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL, Supabase Storage, Row Level Security (RLS), Remote Procedure Calls (RPC), Realtime Subscriptions.
- Firebase: Cloud Firestore, Firebase Authentication, Cloud Functions, Cloud Messaging (FCM), Crashlytics.
- Networking: RESTful APIs, HTTP networking, JSON serialization, WebSockets.

### 3. State Management & Architectural Patterns
- Architecture: Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM), Clean Architecture, Feature-first modular architecture, Repository Pattern.
- State Management: BLoC / Cubit, Provider, Riverpod fundamentals.

### 4. AI & Machine Learning Integration
- Large Language Models: Groq LLM API, Google Gemini API, OpenAI API integration.
- On-Device ML: Google ML Kit, Optical Character Recognition (OCR), Text Recognition, On-device Speech-to-Text (STT) and Text-to-Speech (TTS).
- Prompt Engineering: Context injection, few-shot prompting, conversational assistant design.

### 5. Local Persistence & Databases
- Relational: SQLite, Drift ORM (type-safe queries and reactive streams).
- NoSQL & Key-Value: Hive, SQFlite, Shared Preferences.
- Database migrations, offline-first syncing, and caching.
